brand.name: PianoMind AI
brand.tagline: Turn any song into piano & sheet music with AI

landing.badge: Powered by AI · Audio to notation

hero.subtitle: Upload audio, video, or a link and PianoMind AI transcribes it into a Piano Roll and Sheet Music — with synced piano playback. All in your browser.

features.title: Everything you need to transcribe,
features.subtitle: A complete workflow — from dropping a file to playable notation.

items.title: Upload anything
items.desc: Drag & drop audio or video (MP3, WAV, MP4) or paste a link — the waveform appears instantly.

items.title: Interactive Waveform
items.desc: See the audio, play, pause, seek, and change playback speed — all from one player.

items.title: Smart Piano Roll
items.desc: Every note rendered as bars on piano keys, with key names and lengths matched to timing.

items.title: Automatic Sheet Music
items.desc: Transcribed MIDI becomes standard notation — ready to practice or edit further.

items.title: Synced playback
items.desc: Piano sound (Tone.js) plays the transcription in sync with the original, frame by frame.

items.title: 100% private
items.desc: Basic Pitch runs on your device — your audio never leaves the browser.

how.title: From audio to notation in 3 steps

steps.title: Upload a song
steps.desc: Drop an audio/video file or paste a link. The waveform loads instantly.

steps.title: AI transcribes
steps.desc: Basic Pitch analyzes every note — melody and timing — and turns it into MIDI.

steps.title: Play & export
steps.desc: Switch between Piano Roll and Sheet Music, play synced piano, or export your file.

ctaBand.subtitle: Start free — no signup, nothing to install.

footer.madeWith: Built with Next.js, Tailwind, Tone.js and Basic Pitch
